name: Verandah in the Forest (Dune Barr House)
why_special: 1853 Captain Barr colonial bungalow restored by Neemrana — 11 rooms with original wood floors and verandahs over the Matheran forest. India's earliest hill-station bungalow turned hotel; the only true heritage stay on India's smallest hill station.

name: Lord's Central Hotel
why_special: 1933 Parsi family-run hotel on Matheran's MG Road — vegetarian, no-alcohol, classic colonial wraparound verandahs, the same Lord family running the property for four generations. The senior heritage Parsi hotel in Matheran.

name: Usha Ascot Matheran
why_special: Pure-vegetarian 4-star resort with rope-style cottages across landscaped grounds — outdoor pool (rare for Matheran), multi-cuisine veg restaurant, the modern resort alternative to the Lord's/Verandah heritage axis.
